_style_bloom: Painted in the MLow Impermanent Vision style at Bloom intensity: photoreal materials, fine topographic contour lines in electric cobalt and cyan that wrap around the architecture and follow its form, physical vertical paint drips of hot pink and violet running off ledges, one watchful bone white Open Eye Flower with seven broad petals and a realistic blue iris placed where it witnesses the scene. Ink black and midnight navy darks, restrained copper light, selective electric color only, dense detail near the threshold, quiet dark fields elsewhere. No people's faces. Cinematic, sharp, deep focus, wide lens.
_style_whisper: Photoreal, in the MLow Impermanent Vision style at Whisper intensity: the material is real and readable first, with a faint fine cobalt and cyan topographic contour line field following the surface and one or two small hot pink paint drips. Ink black and midnight navy darks, restrained copper. No people, no faces.
_style_flat: Flat orthographic straight on view, evenly lit, filling the whole frame edge to edge, no perspective, no vignette, no border, no shadows falling off the edge.

jobs.name: p_dream_window
jobs.prompt: The view through the scratched window of a New York subway car at 3:33 in the morning, but the train is crossing the sky: the Manhattan skyline floats on a sea of dark clouds below, water towers and bodega awnings drifting loose like islands, the Queensboro Bridge arching into the clouds, a full moon that is a giant Open Eye Flower watching the train, flocks of pigeons crossing it. Deep space, layered distance, foreground clouds close to the glass, far towers tiny. No window frame visible, just the view.

jobs.name: p_tunnel
jobs.prompt: Looking straight down a New York subway tunnel from the end of an empty platform at 3:33 in the morning: the tracks run away into the dark, green and red signal lamps, steel columns in a long row, the third rail, puddles, and far down the tunnel a single gigantic pigeon standing on the tracks, its head brushing the tunnel ceiling, lit by a work light, calm, looking back. The tunnel walls liquefy into contour lines near the pigeon.

jobs.name: p_street
jobs.prompt: The view out of a corner bodega's front window at night in Jackson Heights, Queens, seen from inside at eye level but without the window frame: a wet street after rain, the 7 train elevated tracks overhead with a lit train passing, a laundromat and a botanica across the road with neon, a halal cart steaming, parked cars, a fire hydrant, a tree pit, a phone booth, puddles reflecting neon, pigeons asleep on the el girders, deep perspective down the avenue.

jobs.name: p_cooler_snow
jobs.prompt: Behind the glass door of a bodega beer cooler there is an endless frozen aisle that goes on for a mile: shelves of cans and milk cartons rimed with frost receding to a vanishing point, snow falling indoors, a pigeon in a tiny scarf walking away down the aisle, cold blue light, deep one point perspective.

jobs.name: p_cooler_beach
jobs.prompt: Behind the glass door of a bodega beer cooler there is Rockaway Beach at dawn: the boardwalk, waves rolling in, a lifeguard chair, seagulls and pigeons on the sand, the sun rising as an Open Eye Flower over the Atlantic, deep perspective along the shoreline, mist.

jobs.name: p_cooler_eye
jobs.prompt: Behind the glass door of a bodega beer cooler there is nothing but one colossal pigeon eye looking back at you from inches away: the orange iris with its fine radial fibres, the black pupil, the grey feathers and pink skin around it, iridescent green and purple neck feathers below, the pupil reflecting the tiny lit bodega and a tiny figure standing in it. Macro photograph scale.

jobs.name: p_cooler_harbor
jobs.prompt: Behind the glass door of a bodega beer cooler there is New York Harbor at night seen from the water: the Statue of Liberty far away wearing a crown of flowers, the Staten Island Ferry lit up and crossing, the Brooklyn Bridge, deep distance, the water black and glossy with copper reflections.

jobs.name: p_heart
jobs.prompt: Inside the heart of a city pigeon imagined as a grand opera house: a vast round red velvet chamber with ribbed muscular walls like theatre boxes, glowing red and violet veins running across the walls like neon tubes, four great valves as arched doorways, a central chandelier made of pulsing light, gold framed paintings hung on the velvet, a lone small figure on the floor, deep perspective, warm and alive, not gory, elegant and theatrical.

jobs.name: p_hall
jobs.prompt: Inside the neck of a pigeon imagined as a cathedral nave: a long vaulted hall whose columns and ribs are made of enormous iridescent green and purple neck feathers, the floor polished grey stone like pigeon plumage, light from far ahead where the hall opens into a glowing chamber, gold framed paintings between the feather columns, one point perspective down the nave, a small lone figure walking away.

jobs.name: p_map
jobs.prompt: Inside the brain of a homing pigeon imagined as a planetarium: a huge dark dome whose ceiling is a glowing map of New York City's five boroughs drawn in cyan contour lines and light, the rivers as rivers of light, magnetic field lines arcing overhead like an aurora, tiny glowing pins at every neighborhood, a lone figure standing on a balcony looking up, deep and vast.

jobs.name: t_bodega_floor
jobs.prompt: Top down texture of a worn New York bodega floor: old cream and black checkerboard vinyl tiles, scuffed, a few cracked tiles, faint grime in the grout, one flattened bottle cap, a lottery ticket corner, seamless tiling texture.

jobs.name: t_subway_floor
jobs.prompt: Top down texture of a New York subway car floor: grey speckled rubber flooring with tiny multicolor flecks, scuffs, a dried coffee ring, faint gum spots, seamless tiling texture.

jobs.name: t_subway_wall
jobs.prompt: Texture of a New York subway car's stainless steel and off white fiberglass interior wall panel, with faint scratchiti tags etched into the surface, rivet lines, light grime, seamless tiling texture.

jobs.name: t_feather
jobs.prompt: Macro photograph texture of city pigeon neck feathers, densely overlapping scale like feathers in iridescent emerald green and amethyst purple shimmering over slate grey, extremely detailed barbs, seamless tiling texture.

jobs.name: t_velvet
jobs.prompt: Texture of deep crimson crushed velvet upholstery with fine glowing violet and hot pink vein lines branching through it like neon, tufted, luxurious, seamless tiling texture.

jobs.name: t_crop
jobs.prompt: Texture of a soft folded pale pink and peach organic wall like the inside of a seashell or rose petals, gentle ridges, faint cobalt topographic contour lines following every fold, clean and beautiful, not gory, seamless tiling texture.

jobs.name: t_terrazzo
jobs.prompt: Top down texture of a polished museum terrazzo floor: warm white base with chips of grey, black, cobalt, copper and a few tiny bone white flower shaped chips, glossy, seamless tiling texture.

jobs.name: t_stickerwall
jobs.prompt: Texture of a New York lamp post or bodega wall completely bombed with hundreds of overlapping vinyl stickers and slaps: eye flower stickers, hello my name is labels, pigeon stickers, band stickers, MetroCard shaped stickers, peeling corners, torn layers, sun faded, seamless tiling texture, dense, colorful but dark.

jobs.name: t_tile
jobs.prompt: Texture of classic New York subway station wall tiles: small cream ceramic subway tiles with a band of cobalt and copper mosaic border, slight grime in the grout, one hairline crack, seamless tiling texture.

jobs.name: t_ceiling
jobs.prompt: Texture of a bodega drop ceiling: off white acoustic ceiling tiles in an aluminum grid, one water stained tile, seamless tiling texture.

jobs.name: t_receipts
jobs.prompt: Top down texture of a pigeon's nest made of crumpled bodega receipts, lottery tickets, twigs, MetroCards and a single dropped earring, densely packed, seamless tiling texture.

jobs.name: g_shelf_snacks
jobs.prompt: Straight on photograph of a full bodega shelf front packed with brightly colored snack bags and boxes of invented MLow brands with clear legible labels: EYE CRUNCH chips, TALLY CHIPS, COO COO PUFFS, PIGEON PEANUTS, BODEGA CAT TREATS, 3:33 AM ENERGY, NAZAR NACHOS, all with small Open Eye Flower logos, rows filling the frame edge to edge, realistic packaging and price tags.

jobs.name: g_shelf_cans
jobs.prompt: Straight on photograph of a bodega cooler shelf packed with cans and bottles of invented MLow drinks with clear legible labels: NAZAR COLA, OPEN EYE SELTZER, COUNTED LAGER, MIDNIGHT NAVY TEA, PINK DRIP SODA, LAST STOP MALT, rows filling the frame edge to edge, condensation, realistic.

jobs.name: g_shelf_home
jobs.prompt: Straight on photograph of a bodega shelf front packed with household goods of invented MLow brands with clear legible labels: EYE DROPS FOR PIGEONS, COUNT ON IT batteries, BODEGA CANDLE saint candles with an Open Eye Flower, SEEDS FOR THE ROOF birdseed, NEW YORKERS lighters, cat food, rows filling the frame edge to edge.

jobs.name: g_awning
jobs.prompt: A classic New York bodega awning sign, straight on, filling the frame: a red and yellow backlit sign reading PIGEONHOLE DELI GROCERY in big bold letters, with smaller lines OPEN 25 HRS, COLD BEER, LOTTO, HERO, and a painted Open Eye Flower and a pigeon on either side, slightly weathered.

jobs.name: g_menu
jobs.prompt: A bodega deli menu board behind the counter, straight on, filling the frame: black board with white letters listing BACON EGG AND CHEESE 4.50, CHOPPED CHEESE 8.00, THE PIGEON (BREAD CRUMBS) 0.25, COFFEE ANY SIZE 1.00, THE DREAM HERO 3.33, ALL DAY BREAKFAST, with small photos of sandwiches, a little Open Eye Flower in the corner.

jobs.name: g_lotto
jobs.prompt: The wall behind a New York bodega counter, straight on, filling the frame: a lottery sign reading MLOWTTO WIN A DREAM, rows of scratch off tickets in a dispenser, a handwritten sign NO CREDIT CARD UNDER $5, a saint candle with an Open Eye Flower, a cat calendar, phone cards, a small evil eye charm.

jobs.name: g_metrocard
jobs.prompt: A single fare card seen flat straight on filling the whole frame like a product shot, in the classic yellow and blue transit card style but rebranded: it reads PIGEONCARD in bold blue letters and ONE WAY DOWN, with a magnetic stripe, a small Open Eye Flower logo, an arrow, fine print about the dream line, slightly worn.

jobs.name: g_poster_pigeon
jobs.prompt: A subway platform poster, straight on filling the frame, advertising an exhibition: big type reading THE PIGEON WILL SEE YOU NOW and smaller type A MUSEUM INSIDE A PIGEON INSIDE A BODEGA INSIDE A DREAM, n3wyorkers.com, with a monumental grey pigeon whose eye is an Open Eye Flower.

jobs.name: g_poster_bodega
jobs.prompt: A subway platform poster, straight on filling the frame: big type reading SMALLER ON THE INSIDE and small type THE PIGEONHOLE, n3wyorkers.com, showing a bodega at night with a giant pigeon inside it that contains a tiny museum that contains a tiny bodega, recursive, Droste effect.

jobs.name: g_poster_wake
jobs.prompt: A subway platform poster, straight on filling the frame: big type reading DO NOT WAKE THE DREAMER and smaller type THIS IS THE LAST STOP. IT IS ALSO THE FIRST., n3wyorkers.com, showing a sleeping figure on an orange subway seat while the car floats through clouds.
